text: The sterile clarity of the meeting room, juxtaposed with the creative chaos of the R+D display, evokes in me a sense of anticipation. I feel like I'm on the threshold between potentiality and realization, theory and practice. The world here is fragmented yet inviting, urging me to ponder what it is to innovate and to belong to spaces engineered for thought and progress. I feel curious—perhaps even quietly inspired.
